The '''X-70B ''Phantom''-class prototype''' was a prototype starship of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|reconstituted Sith Empire]] used by [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:ExalKresshX70B-BOTE3.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Exal Kressh's starship en route to Korriban]]
The sleek appearance of the X-70B ''Phantom'' was designed to pass for a [[Shuttle/Legends|civilian luxury shuttle]], despite its array of hidden components. Its bridge was shielded by the forward armor plating, and was equipped with advanced, precision flight instruments.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Its interior featured custom wood panelling and cushioned seating, and within the X-70B was a luxurious central lounge with a gaming table and recessed food coolers, as well as a long-range communications holoterminal. Attached to the lounge was a medical bay, behind which was a spacious cargo bay. The X-70B also included a conference room, intended for both briefings and entertainment of potential intelligence sources.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

X-70Bs were so technologically advanced they were never mass-produced. Instead, they were elite vessels bestowed upon only the most trusted intelligence agents for the most vital missions to the Empire during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The ships were coated with a sensor-resistant exterior and equipped with the most sophisticated equipment and weapons. Their powerful sensor arrays had the ability to scan the interiors of other ships, even over large distances.<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|starships|x-70b-phantom|X-70B Phantom}}</ref>

==History==
[[Exal Kressh]], [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]], piloted an X-70B prototype when she defected from the Emperor's service. She first traveled in her ship to an unidentified planet in the [[Peragus system/Legends|Peragus system]],<ref name="Shades of the Sith">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 1: Shades of the Sith]]''</ref> before she was pursued by a fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] apprentice, [[Darth Thanaton|Teneb Kel]]. She then used it to escape from the destroyed [[Lenico Colony Blue]]<ref name="Broken World">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 2: The Broken World]]''</ref> and return to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] in the [[Horuset system]] shortly before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Battle over Korriban|attack on Korriban]]<ref name="Burn the Future">''[[The Old Republic, Blood of the Empire Act 3: Burn the Future]]''</ref>.

Another of these ships would be given to be used as the [[Cipher Nine's X-70B Phantom-class prototype|personal ship]] of an [[Imperial Agent]] named [[Cipher Nine]] in order to travel across the galaxy on various operations from transport to space battles.<ref name="Cleaning Up the Mess">{{TORcite|type=class|Imperial Agent|Cleaning Up the Mess|Dromund Kaas}}</ref>

[[Darth Serevin]] used an X-70B during the [[Battle of Ilum]] where he oversaw [[Darth Malgus]]'s New Empire forces. His ship was captured during the battle and used to deliver a strike force to [[Emperor's Fortress|Malgus' space station]], which eliminated the false emperor.<ref name="The Battle for Ilum">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Battle for Ilum}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The X-70B is the [[Imperial Agent]] class ship in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.
